summary: Lloyds Bank plc filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, under the SEC's foreign private issuer reporting rules. The filing presents IFRS-based balance sheets, income statements, segment results (Retail, Commercial Banking, Other), and equity changes for 2026 and comparative periods. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed; the document is a routine periodic financial report equivalent to a quarterly/annual report. What to watch: future filings for any substantive corporate actions or strategic announcements.
